purpose: Resolve the selected morning-to-afternoon market-coupling concept into one exact no-value mechanism and challenge it against terminal and prospective families before any Campaign030 source partition, frozen benchmark value, candidate value, comparison value, daily price, or forward return is opened.

selected_mechanism.name: intraday_market_correlation_resolution_119p
selected_mechanism.formula: population PearsonCorr(stock_return, leave_one_out_market_return) over the 119 morning within-half return positions minus the same population Pearson correlation over the 119 afternoon within-half return positions
selected_mechanism.economic_hypothesis: A higher value means common-market signed-return coupling weakened from morning to afternoon, representing resolution of morning common-liquidity pressure and renewed stock-specific price formation that may carry from the next open through the third close.
selected_mechanism.return_grid: Form 119 adjacent natural-log close returns inside each 120-close half at 09:31-11:30 and 13:01-15:00. Morning positions are 0-118 and afternoon positions are 119-237. Exclude standalone 09:30 and the lunch transition.
selected_mechanism.leave_one_out_rule: At each return position subtract the stock's own finite return and count from the frozen equal-weight market return sum and valid-stock count, then divide the remaining sum by the remaining count.
selected_mechanism.peer_rule: Require at least 50 other finite stock returns at every one of the 238 positions.
selected_mechanism.correlation_rule: Compute two separate equal-position-weight population Pearson correlations: one on the complete 119-element morning stock and leave-one-out market signed-return vectors, and one on the complete 119-element afternoon vectors. Require strictly positive population variance in both stock and both leave-one-out market half vectors.
selected_mechanism.resolution_rule: Subtract the afternoon correlation from the morning correlation exactly once. Do not take an absolute value, use one-minus-correlation, pool the halves, fit beta or residuals, condition on signs or magnitudes, use leads or lags, or add weights, thresholds, quantiles, filters, or subwindows.
selected_mechanism.zero_rule: Retain exact-zero stock and leave-one-out market returns at their fixed positions without removal, bridging, replacement, tolerance reclassification, or sign conditioning.
selected_mechanism.endpoint_rule: Canonicalize each half-correlation only when it lies within 1e-12 beyond -1 or +1; otherwise a nonfinite or out-of-range component makes the stock-day missing. The final exact difference must lie within [-2,2].
selected_mechanism.missing_rule: Any invalid close-return grid, insufficient leave-one-out peer position, nonfinite stock or market return, nonpositive population variance in any required half vector, invalid component correlation, nonfinite final score, or final score outside [-2,2] makes the stock-day missing; never fill, statistically clip, repair, or substitute.

overlap_challenges.reason: Market-idiosyncratic share fits one pooled signed market exposure and summarizes pooled residual-to-total variance. Campaign030 fits no beta or residual variance and retains only the difference between two separately standardized half-session correlations.

The residual-drift factor fits a pooled signed market relation and ranks a directional late residual window. Campaign030 has no residual return or selected late window and compares two complete half-session correlation states.

Campaign021 subtracts stock-lag and stock-lead cross correlations over pooled within-half positions. Campaign030 is strictly synchronous and subtracts afternoon state from morning state, with no lead or lag.

Campaign026 partitions all positions by strictly positive versus strictly negative market returns. Campaign030 never conditions on return sign and instead uses complete morning versus complete afternoon time blocks.

Campaign029 removes signs and computes one pooled magnitude correlation. Campaign030 retains signed returns, computes two half-session correlations, and measures their ordered decline. It does not rescue or modify Campaign029.

Campaign027 correlates the stock's own morning return sequence with its own corresponding afternoon sequence and reads no market state. Campaign030 never correlates morning observations with afternoon observations; each half is separately related only to its synchronous leave-one-out market.

Volatility resolution compares the stock's marginal return-variance allocation through time without a market benchmark. Campaign030 uses signed standardized dependence against an external market path and is invariant to each half's positive scale.
Candidate49 measures causal cumulative-VWAP crossings from close, volume, and amount. Campaign030 reads no volume or amount and has no cumulative VWAP or crossing count.
Campaign030 contains one new close-plus-frozen-market statistic and no terminal factor value, fitted transform, filter, model, combination, or Campaign029 cost relaxation.

design_choices_frozen_before_values.formula_family: morning synchronous signed-return population Pearson correlation minus afternoon synchronous signed-return population Pearson correlation
